messages:
Alyssa Chen: Heads-up  Sierra Health renewal call on Monday asked for a clear SLA pack + an example credit calc if the recent latency tail counts. They also want to know whether unfinished onboarding sessions affect eligibility. @Raj can you pull 30d telemetry and minutes-over-threshold? @Emma can you confirm whether the 04/18 p95 jump was infra or rollout? Need a compact one-pager by EOD.

Raj Patel: Pulling now. 30d headline: uptime 99.96%, p50 ~68ms, p95 ~275ms. Notable spike 2026-04-18 05:44 UTC. Minutes-over-p95 (per contract baseline 250ms) ~1.4% for the month. CSV snippet and chart link: https://redwood.internal/metrics/sierra/2045678901

Emma Rivera: 04/18 aligns with a background storage node rebalance that increased read latency and caused KV-cache churn. No model push. We applied a staggered rebalance fix and a cache-priming job.

Mike O'Neill: Contract SLOs: monthly uptime 99.95%, p95 <=250ms. Contract defines credit when >1% of minutes exceed p95 OR uptime falls below SLO. Sierra's ~1.4% meets the latency-trigger so they're eligible. I'll draft the credit calc.

Olivia Park: Renewal context: Sierra is worried about reliability and also asked whether incomplete enablement (they've missed the "alerting" session) affects credits. We should be explicit: credits tied to telemetry only, but offer a sequencing of enablement to close concerns.

Alyssa Chen: Proposed concessions: (A) apply contract credit per formula, (B) offer optional 3-month trial of Dedicated with a 10% usage discount (to lower tail risk) as a signing incentive, conditional on completing the remaining enablement session within 30 days. Ask legal if the Dedicated trial is OK to offer.

Mike O'Neill: Draft credit calc (prelim): monthly fee $25k, minutes-over-threshold 1.4% => prorated credit ~4% invoice credit. Legal flagged we must cite telemetry export as source. I'll add wording.

legal-bot: Confirmed: we can offer a time-limited Dedicated trial discount as a commercial concession provided we include expiry and scope in the renewal amendment. Telemetry export must be attached for credit calculation evidence.

Raj Patel: Attached export: https://redwood.internal/exports/sierra-2045678901.csv and small trend chart uploaded.

Alyssa Chen: Great. I'll draft the 1-pager: include the automatic ~4% credit (per contract), optional Dedicated trial + 10% discount as a one-time signing incentive, and a short RCA + mitigation timeline. Meeting invite sent Mon 9:30 AM PT to review. Drop any edits here.

calendar-bot: Meeting scheduled: Sierra Health SLA & renewal review  Monday 9:30 AM PT (invite sent).
